company_profile: 2K is a video game publisher behind franchises such as NBA 2K, whose Applied AI team builds matchmaking, skill rating, personalisation and fraud models for players.
title: Senior Applied Scientist
summary: Applied scientist with 8+ years taking machine learning models from prototype to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Works with deep learning and embedding models, from a fine-tuned cross-encoder for re-ranking to Sentence-BERT representations for clustering and a reranker for recommendations, on data prepared with Python, SQL and PySpark. Turns ambiguous product problems into well-defined ML tasks with stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.original: Fine-tuned a cross-encoder on positive and negative pairs
experience_edits.new: Fine-tuned a cross-encoder embedding model on positive and negative pairs to re-rank dense retrieval over AARP survey data, improving ranking and retrieval accuracy.

experience_edits.original: Built an event-correlation engine clustering alarms with Sentence-BERT
experience_edits.new: Built an event-correlation engine that embedded alarms with Sentence-BERT and clustered them with DBSCAN, tracing cascading alarm floods to the root event and improving semantic alarm classification by 73.5%.

experience_edits.original: Implemented a reranker for an existing recommendation system
experience_edits.new: Implemented a ranking model on top of an existing recommendation system serving individual and child plan recommendations, personalising renewal suggestions and increasing conversion by 2%.

experience_edits.original: Deployed a production SLA breach prediction system
experience_edits.new: Deployed a production SLA breach prediction model with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow, using GPT-3.5 for real-time root-cause analysis and remediation per breach, reducing downtime by 67%.
Prototyped 15+ AI applications for AIOps and GeoPerformance clients, turning ambiguous client requirements into well-defined ML tasks, with 7 moving into production or paid client work.

project.name: Sequential Player Skill Model
bullets: Built an LSTM sequence model in PyTorch that learned player skill embeddings from match event histories, using contrastive training on paired outcomes to support fairer matchmaking and skill rating.
Evaluated the embeddings on held-out match outcome prediction against an Elo baseline, tracked experiments in MLflow, and served skill scores through a FastAPI service in Docker.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Applied Scientist role on the Applied AI team at 2K. For more than eight years I have built models that end up in production, from embedding-based retrieval and alarm clustering in telecom to agents in healthcare. What ties them together is turning a vague problem into a model people actually use.

NBA 2K is a game where small modelling choices shape how every match feels, and that is the kind of problem I want to work on: fair matchmaking, honest skill ratings and personalisation players notice. There is a personal side too. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Dublin together and settle there long term.

I would bring a habit of getting the representation right before the model. At Viavi I embedded network alarms with Sentence-BERT and clustered them with DBSCAN, which improved semantic alarm classification by 73.5%. At United Health Group I fine-tuned a cross-encoder to re-rank dense retrieval, and at Optum a reranker I added to a plan recommender lifted conversion by 2%.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has taught me to design for the people on the other end of a model and to test with them rather than guess. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
